title: Modular quickstart slide kit with live-stream GIFs and dark-mode comps
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a modular slide kit and supporting assets for the Sales quickstart narrative that are derived from actual product screenshots and short live-stream GIFs of streaming responses. Deliverables: 1) 10-slide master deck in 16:9 with modular components (hero, onboarding steps, cost/latency callouts, feature highlights); 2) Dark-mode variants for all hero and step slides; 3) Animated GIFs (3–5s) showing streaming generation, function/tool calling, and embeddings search for use on social and in demos; 4) PNG handout sheets and a compressed ZIP of assets ready for the field; 5) Localization-ready source files (text layers separated, placeholder copy keys). Must align with Redwood brand typography, accessible color contrast, and be optimized for both Google Slides and Keynote. Avoid screenshots of PII; blur any user-specific data. Coordinate with Eng for getting latest streaming demo PR (#GH-9802) and with PM for messaging sign-off.
